title: Fix the Infinite Factorial
description: The program should compute the factorial of a number using recursion. Fix the bug.
expectedBehavior: The program should print 120, the factorial of 5.
actualProblem: There is no base case to stop the recursion, so factorial keeps calling itself with smaller and smaller n forever (n, n-1, n-2, ... into negative numbers), eventually raising a RecursionError.
explanation: Every recursive function needs a base case — a condition where it stops calling itself and returns directly. Without one, the recursion never terminates and exhausts the call stack.
